title: Divergence: proof-backends.md §4 stabilized form vs REQ-7/§8 AUTO-discharge claims — z3-demotion evidence is shallow QF_LIA; no normalization/fuel-irrelevance story makes the ∃N∀fuel deep-embedded obligation smt-reachable

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Groundedness gap (no kernel pin possible — the defect is an ABSENCE). §4's exported obligation is '∀ v : Env, stabilizesProp req {v with specs := R_item} → stabilizesProp ens …' — an ∃N∀fuel statement over the deep embedding (denote/intVal applied to Expr encodings). REQ-7(i)/§8/Verification-(ii) claim the AUTO battery (omega/simp/decide/Lean-SMT smt) discharges the scalar-contract corpus obligations, grounded in z3-demotion.md — but that PoC discharged SHALLOW QF_LIA theorems (z3-demotion.md: 'tv_obligation_arith_cmp (a b c : Int) : (a - b ≤ c) ↔ (a ≤ c + b)'), hand-translated, with no denote, no stabilizesProp wrapper. Lean-SMT's smt will not chew ∃N∀fuel goals over a deep embedding; decide/simp cannot synthesize the env-dependent ∃N witness (N depends on |xs| for recursive specs — needs induction). The doc's only bridge is the fuel₀-hint sentence (an unfolding budget — addresses neither ∃N elimination nor deep→shallow normalization). Missing: a named normalization story, e.g. a fuel-irrelevance lemma (specCall-free e ⇒ denote fuel-independent ⇒ stabilizesProp ↔ denote 0) letting the exporter emit FUEL-FREE shallow statements for the auto fragment — without it increment (ii)'s AC fails by design.
